title: Compile animation assets to semantic refs
summary: Added a pure AnimationAsset semantic-ref compiler that projects animation objects and transformations into existing SemanticObjectRef and SemanticTransformationRef shapes, with lightweight timeline, layout, render-target refs, and validation diagnostics for downstream consumers.
